instrument: Shelby County Health Department air permit, xAI Colossus 1 (July 2025)
summary: Air permit issued to xAI for gas turbines at the Colossus 1 site in South Memphis after more than a year of operation without one; aerial photography in March 2025 showed 35 turbines, at least 33 operating a month later.

source.citation: SELC; E&E News, Mar 2026; TechCrunch, June 2025

notes: Permit commonly reported as covering 15 turbines; unverified. SELC appealed on behalf of NAACP and Young, Gifted & Green.
confidence_note: Permit not read; turbine count covered by the permit unconfirmed.
